notes.title: Solutions for extensions not working anymore after a recent update
notes.notes:
Due to the Steam platform's policy adjustment for the visibility of expanded content in some regions, we have updated the game client for the game products released in the past (before September 7, 2022) to adapt to the policy adjustment. This round of updates will involve the above The game client for all released products before time. Due to the large number of game products, we will gradually update the game client until all the updates are completed. At the same time, players who have purchased and downloaded and installed the complete game need to update the game client and Through this program:

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LovelyGamesStudios/announcements/detail/3344507206081045272
for more content. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to players during this period.
While continuing to update the previous game client, we will also continue to carry out several rounds of Lovely Games game cdk lucky draw activities.

We have sorted out the main problems reported by users recently, and provided some solutions. Players can view and try to solve the problem. If the problem still exists after trying it by yourself, please describe the details of the problem and leave a message under this discussion:

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LovelyGamesStudios/discussions/0/3371530631528314460/

We sincerely hope that all players will continue to support Lovely Games! At the same time, please pay attention to the new game in October: Assassin's Vol. Experience the beautiful journey of Miss Assassin.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096790
